geometry.inverse_stability_margin: 1/(1+max(3*r_near^2-beta,0)) where r_near is nearest stable real root
geometry.stable_mode_separation: distance between outer stable roots when three real roots, else 0

alarm_threshold: 90th percentile of each model's own training probabilities
event_cluster: maximal contiguous run of positive target months

placebos.shuffle: single deterministic row permutation seed 730074 applied to geometry before split
placebos.circular_shift: geometry circularly shifted forward by exactly 60 monthly rows before split

bootstrap.studentization: bootstrap standard deviation per metric; one-sided simultaneous critical value from max of (observed-bootstrap)/sd

secondary_breadth.index: equal-weight mean daily simple return of available panel members
secondary_breadth.breadth: fraction of members above their trailing 200-session moving average
